Name: (SVE) Sandy Portrait Revised
Author: Milkshxs
Description:
[b][u]How to install:[/u][/b]
[b]1. [/b]Download the png file you want (original bangs or altered bangs)
[b]2. [/b]Go into your "mods" folder for Stardew Valley
[b]3.[/b] Go to Stardew Valley Expanded: [CP] Stardew Valley Expanded: assets: Characterfiles: Portraits: Sandy
[b]4.[/b] Replace the Sandy.png with the portrait downloaded and you're done! 
She should load perfectly in game with no issues!!

(It maybe sounds complex but it's really simple, just replace her SVE portrait with the revised png of your choice :)

If anyone has any issues, PLEASE let me know in the comments! (everything should be fine as its just a simple png revision but if not let me know!)

Also if anyone has suggestions for more adjusted portraits/feedback on how I can improve my portraits it is much appreciated!!

And finally if anyone wants any more portraits changed please let me know! (Only SVE right now as I'm not entirely sure how to change the regular-characters portraits yet but any suggestions are welcome :)

[i]Have a nice day and ty for downloading!![/i]
